title: Rozanne Slik
passages: Rozanne Slik (born 12 April 1991) is a Dutch racing cyclist, who competes in mountain biking for the KMC Mountainbike Team. Prior to this, Slik also competed in road bicycle racing from 2013 to 2021 for five different UCI Women's Teams – and took two professional victories, winning stages at the 2015 Auensteiner–Radsporttage, and the 2018 Thüringen Rundfahrt der Frauen.
She is the sister of racing cyclist Ivar Slik.
